observations.summary: September 2026 exact-origin HTTPS CrUX record is found in coarse 5,000,000 bucket. The 572,851 annual pageviews scenario uses a bucket median calibrated on US government websites with 2025 analytics and December 2025 ranks. It is neither measured site traffic nor a forecast, with no calibrated site-level interval; no parent-domain substitution occurred.

SWDM uses first recorded initial visits from eight successful document navigations, each weighted 0.125. The HTTP 429 documentation-guidelines run is explicitly excluded by excludeFailedPages. All included transfer inputs remain partial. Weighted 0.167253203325 g/view × 572,851 views ÷ 1,000 = 95.81116477792956 kgCO2e/year; arithmetic and input digests match. The non-green hosting flag is an unknown-hosting modeling assumption, with 100% first visits and global model electricity factors. No DCR is assigned.

6.364607072935801–276.5173832909202 kg/year represents all views at the least/most intensive sampled successful page, not a confidence interval or bounds on real emissions. Equal sample weights proxy an unknown actual page mix. The modeled operational and embodied browsing scope excludes a complete organizational/backend/build inventory.

The smaller energy sample contains home, tutorial and images only, three validated initial-load repetitions per URL. Equal weights across their client-device medians yield 0.0140626694774 Wh/view; × 572,851 ÷ 1,000 = 8.055814272798068 kWh/year; × 494 gCO2e/kWh ÷ 1,000 = 3.9795722507622457 kgCO2e/year. This is browser CPU/memory/disk/display operation only and excludes modeled network, remote servers, embodied emissions and subsequent reading. Values overlap SWDM device scope and must remain separate.

Manifest retains 1280×800 Chromium initial navigation plus 3 seconds, browser/container lifecycle window, no baseline subtraction, sequential shared workstation, fixed 45 W CPU/14 W screen coefficients and normalized CPU counters. The 494 gCO2e/kWh factor is an assumed comparison factor, not observed audience electricity. Nine audited URLs, eight successful SWDM URLs and three energy URLs are distinct denominators.

issues.summary: The calculations are internally consistent but depend on incomplete transfer, unknown page mix and visit mix, cross-population traffic calibration and a smaller laboratory energy sample. Numerical precision does not improve these assumptions.
issues.requestedChange: Present approximately 96 kgCO2e/year SWDM and, separately, 8.1 kWh/year / 4.0 kgCO2e/year GreenFrame only as explicit scenarios. Keep the failed 429 exclusion and eight-versus-three samples visible; retain the model, dataset month, calibration population, first-visit assumption and coverage caveats near the figures. Do not claim measured annual emissions, a DCR badge, a complete inventory or statistical bounds.

issues.summary: The configured 10% reduction is a scale sensitivity at unchanged traffic, not demonstrated achievable savings.
issues.requestedChange: Label any percentage-reduction illustration hypothetical. Require matched before/after evidence and affected-traffic share before attributing annual savings to a specific finding; never add GreenFrame and SWDM results.
